synonimy: Crotalidae Polyvalent Immune Fab (North American Snake Antivenom)
sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Crotalidae polyvalent immune Fab is used to treat crotalid envenomation (rattlesnakes, copperheads, cottonmouths, water moccasins). No information is available on the clinical use of crotalidae polyvalent immune Fab during breastfeeding. Because it is a large protein molecule, the amount in milk is likely to be very low. It is also likely to be partially destroyed in the infant's gastrointestinal tract and absorption by the infant is probably minimal.
